{{Quote|I've seen the Forbidden Gardens of the Nuswatta. I've seen&mdash;and sacked&mdash;the innermost chamber of the Poborandurannum of Natinati.|Jabba to Bib Fortuna|<ref name="Betrayal" />}}
'''Natinati''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWENatinati">{{CSWECite|II|363|Natinati}}</ref> in the [[Natinati system/Legends|Natinanti system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> The sacred temple [[Poborandurannum]] was located on the planet.<ref name="CSWENatinati" /> At a [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="DHCT">The date of ''[[Jabba the Hutt: Betrayal]]'' is established to be [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]] by {{DarkHorse|url=Zones/StarWars/Timeline|text=Comics Timeline}}. As Jabba mentions sacking Poborandurannum in the story, the event must have happened by that date.</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="Betrayal" /> a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]],<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> came to the planet to explore Poborandurannum<ref name="CSWENatinati" /> and sacked it during his visit.<ref name="Betrayal" /> When Jabba returned to his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Betrayal" /> in 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="DHCT" /> the Hutt mentioned the planet and the sacking to his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]].<ref name="Betrayal" />
